text: One can never consent to creep when one feels an impulse to soar.
author: Helen Keller

archive.text: Our strength grows out of our weaknesses.
archive.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

archive.text: Look at the sky. We are not alone. The whole universe is friendly to us.
archive.author: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

archive.text: To dream of the person you would like to be is to waste the person you are.
archive.author: Tim Menchen

archive.text: The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
archive.author: Socrates

archive.text: When the soul of a man is born in this country there are nets flung at it to hold it back from flight.
archive.author: James Joyce

archive.text: We are what we think. All that we are arises with our thoughts. With our thoughts, we make the world.
archive.author: Gautama Buddha

archive.text: In war, the moral is to the physical as three is to one.
archive.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
